name: Yamiiro no Snow Drops
original_name: 闇色のスノードロップス
source:
This is the first title by Iris. Preparing for the university entrance exams for the third time, Takashi lives an unemployed life without any goals. But one day, he gets a call from his aunt Tsubaki, inviting him to come to the countryside to help out with the newspaper stand until the exam time. He reunites with his cousin and osananajimi and feels like he is part of their family, but he is gradually drawn in to the darkness that surrounds them.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Iris的首部作品。为第三次大学入学考试备考的隆没有目标，过着无业生活。一天，姨母椿叫他到乡下，在考试前帮忙经营报刊亭。他与表妹和青梅竹马重逢，感到自己是她们家庭的一员，却逐渐被笼罩她们的黑暗吸引。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
